printed_table_verification: At high magnification on the original page 4 of both PDFs, the greater-than symbols on ANC 1 and platelets 100 are underlined. This means ≥1 AND ≥100 ×10⁹/L meet the routine Table 1 count criterion. Either count below its limit delays. The patient’s performance status and individual count plan can require higher thresholds. A text-only rendering drops the underlines. The 28-day protocol previously treated equality as an unresolved gap.
renal_boundaries: GFR ≤20 excludes administration; >20 through 30 warrants extreme caution. Risk of myelosuppression increases below 60. GFR for the Calvert calculation is capped at 125. A current estimated result uses serum creatinine from within 48 hours. Reuse of an isotope GFR requires serum creatinine at most 110% of its reference value.
indication_change: The 28-day protocol now exposes the exact source indication selector. In both protocols concordance is checked when the user supplies both an exact source indication and a clinical disease setting. An explicit mismatch requires consultant review before using a dose.
